Let's match them!|audio = Sk8P4rkProWave13.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 13 ([[The Takeover Event]], Pro)}} }} ==Description== The '''Failed Experiment''' is an enemy that appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. While it does not appear in Molten Arena [[PVP]] naturally, it can be sent by a player there. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health, higher than every enemy that appeared before it, and walks at an above average speed. Additionally, it spawns a [[Slime]] upon death. ==Appearance== The '''Failed Experiment''' is a humanoid with lower limbs in its rig. In place of legs, it has a tail made of a translucent green goo coming out of its damaged torso, with a large swaying spine attached to it. It has teal tumors and green veins across its body, as well as a line of stitches on its head. It is missing part of its right forearm, which reveals a large bone. It has a death animation, where its arms will give out from under itself, making it fall to its stomach. ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Hunter]] can be used to deal with the '''Failed Experiment'''. **The [[Commander]] should be used to further boost the firerate of these towers. *Upon death, the '''Failed Experiment''' will summon in a [[Slime]]. **This, however, is not that large of an issue as the [[Slime]] itself has a low amount of health. *Slowing towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] can be used to slow the '''Failed Experiment''' down. **Do note that it is a large enemy, meaning certain forms of stalling like freezing or knockback are less effective on it. **Its [[Stun Immunity]] also makes stuns less effective on it. *[[Railgun Tank]]s spawned by the [[Military Base]] can severely damage the '''Failed Experiment''' with its collision damage. **It can also be used to handle the hordes that spawn with it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FailedExperimentWalkAnimation.gif|Walk animation (3 May 2024 – Present) FailedExperimentDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (3 May 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FailedEx.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2FailedEx.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFailedExperiment.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NEWGAMEMODETHUMBNAIL.png|'''Failed Experiment''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} IntermediateThumbailParadoxumPI.png|'''Failed Experiment''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer -
